description: Two loops use the counter 'i' (8 uses in all) but 'int i;' was never declared.
injected_faults: line 6: first use of 'i' in 'for (i = 0; ...)' with no declaration of 'i' anywhere
notes: Cascade: every later use of 'i' (lines 6 (rest of the header), 7, 9 and 10) is a symptom under the first undeclared use on line 6. gcc reports 'i' undeclared only at its first use; the compiler should group every further use under this root.
